summary: Ansible 10 community.aws modules migrated to amazon.aws: iam_group, iam_managed_policy, iam_mfa_device_info, iam_password_policy, iam_role, iam_role_info, s3_bucket_info and sts_assume_role; playbooks using the old FQCN should switch to amazon.aws.
questions: Where did iam_role move in Ansible 10?
Which IAM modules moved from community.aws to amazon.aws?

answer_card.title: IAM and STS modules moved to amazon.aws (Ansible 10)
answer_card.answer_md: Update these FQCNs from `community.aws.*` to `amazon.aws.*`: `iam_group`, `iam_managed_policy`, `iam_mfa_device_info`, `iam_password_policy`, `iam_role`, `iam_role_info`, `s3_bucket_info` and `sts_assume_role`.
